name: Grand Kangxi Communication Technologies (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Grand Kangxi Communication Technologies (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells RF front-end products based on the combination of GaAs and CMOS technologies in China. It provides front-end modules, amplifiers, switches, LNA + SW modules, and diplexers for applications in the Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 5, IoT, and V2X markets. It also designs and offers millimeter-wave integrated circuits. Grand Kangxi Communication Technologies (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2014 and is based in Shanghai, China.
